Name: PLAYER_COMMON_PARAM_ST
Description: Global player settings: the hero level cap, item slot counts, and the settings of the heroes' skills and Ultimate Arts (Claw Shot, Restage, Revenant's summons, marking, analysis and crafting levels, trance and more). Only row 0 is used.

Fields.Name: Automatic Foot Effect SFX Identifier
Fields.Description: Footstep effect group: the last three digits of automatic footstep SFX IDs.

Fields.Name: Precision Shoot - Player Model Fade Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the player model takes to fade out when aiming in first person (bows, crossbows).

Fields.Name: Toughness Recovery Correction
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the player's poise recovery time.

Fields.Name: Base Memory Slot Count
Fields.Description: Memory slots the player has with no Memory Stones.

Fields.Name: Base Talisman Slot Count
Fields.Description: Talisman equipment slot initial value

Fields.Name: Base Item Slot Count
Fields.Description: Item (pouch) slots a hero starts with. Slots gained from other sources are added to it, and the sum is capped at Max Item Slot Count; one further bonus can go past that cap, but never above 10 slots. Retail: 4.

Fields.Name: Max Item Slot Count
Fields.Description: Cap on Base Item Slot Count plus the added slots (see Base Item Slot Count). The game also uses it to check whether a hero already has the full number of slots. Retail: 8.

Fields.Name: Item Pick-up - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation for picking up dropped items.

Fields.Name: Player Resist Recovery - Sleep
Fields.Description: Sleep buildup the player loses per second.

Fields.Name: Flare Overwrite Homing Angle
Fields.Description: Turn rate, in degrees per second, forced on homing projectiles while a flare effect is active. -1: no override.

Fields.Name: Flare Overwrite Homing Stop Range
Fields.Description: Distance, in metres, at which homing stops while a flare effect is active. -1: no override.

Fields.Name: Sleep Collector Item Pick-up - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation for taking an item from a sleeping enemy.

Fields.Name: Weapon Affinity Unlock - Base Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: First event flag for unlocking weapon affinities. Affinity N is unlocked by flag base + N x step.

Fields.Name: Great Rune Activation - SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Special effect Id to call when a large rune is activated from the system

Fields.Name: Insufficient Stats - Attack Power Reduction
Fields.Description: Attack rate lost when wielding a weapon without the required stats (0.4: attacks deal 60%).

Fields.Name: Insufficient Stats - Stamina Consumption
Fields.Description: Stamina cost multiplier for weapons used without the required stats.

Fields.Name: Insufficient Stats - Stamina Damage Reduction
Fields.Description: Guard-break value used for weapons wielded without the required stats.

Fields.Name: Guard Boost Correction - Max Value
Fields.Description: Stat value at which the stat bonus to guard performance stops increasing.

Fields.Name: Weapon Affinity Unlock - Event Flag Step Offset
Fields.Description: Flag spacing between affinities. Affinity N is unlocked by flag base + N x step.

Fields.Name: Retribution Magic - Damage Trigger Count
Fields.Description: Hits taken, within the time window, that trigger a retaliation spell.

Fields.Name: Retribution Magic - Damage Trigger Duration
Fields.Description: Seconds within which the hits must land to trigger the retaliation spell.

Fields.Name: Retribution Magic - Explosion Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Player dummy poly the retaliation spell is cast from.

Fields.Name: Retribution Magic - Explosion Magic Param ID
Fields.Description: Magic cast by the retaliation effect.

Fields.Name: Mounted Precision Shoot - Camera Offset Height
Fields.Description: Camera height offset when aiming in first person while mounted.

Fields.Name: Claw Shot Attack ID
Fields.Description: Player attack (AtkParam_Pc) of Wylder's Claw Shot. When this attack hits, the hit character becomes the Claw Shot target and its distance is recorded. Retail: 600000000 (Claw Shot, going out).

Fields.Name: Quiver Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the quiver is attached to.

Fields.Name: Bolt Case Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the bolt case is attached to. A bolt case used on its own uses the quiver dummy poly.

Fields.Name: Multiplayer Flask Reduction
Fields.Description: Flask multiplier for summoned players: they get owned flasks x this, rounded down.

Fields.Name: Kick Acceptance Angle
Fields.Description: Angle, in degrees, in front of the player within which a kick can be performed.

Fields.Name: NPC Player - Weight Rate Light
Fields.Description: Movement input strength, in percent, for light-load NPC players.

Fields.Name: NPC Player - Weight Rate Normal
Fields.Description: Movement input strength, in percent, for medium-load NPC players.

Fields.Name: NPC Player - Weight Rate Heavy
Fields.Description: Movement input strength, in percent, for heavy-load NPC players.

Fields.Name: NPC Player - Weight Rate Encumbered
Fields.Description: Movement input strength, in percent, for overloaded NPC players.

Fields.Name: NPC Player - Weight Rate Ninja
Fields.Description: Movement input strength, in percent, for NPC players under the lightest weight class.

Fields.Name: Executor Beast NPC ID
Fields.Description: NPC (NpcParam) spawned for Executor's Aspect of the Crucible: Beast. Retail: 100000.

Fields.Name: Game Clear - Base SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect for the first journey. New Game+ cycle N applies this ID + (N - 1).

Fields.Name: Ammunition Model ID Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the arrow or bolt model ID for the second ammo slot.

Fields.Name: Ammunition Count Model Mask Threshold 1
Fields.Description: Remaining ammo, in percent, above which the quiver shows its first fill step.

Fields.Name: Ammunition Count Model Mask Threshold 2
Fields.Description: Remaining ammo, in percent, above which the quiver shows its second fill step.

Fields.Name: Hero Max Level
Fields.Description: Highest level a hero can reach. Level gains (including level changes from SpEffects) are clamped between 1 and this value, and the level-up menu stops offering levels at it. Retail: 15.

Fields.Name: Player Resist Recovery - Poison
Fields.Description: Poison buildup the player loses per second.

Fields.Name: Player Resist Recovery - Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Scarlet Rot buildup the player loses per second.

Fields.Name: Player Resist Recovery - Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Blood Loss buildup the player loses per second.

Fields.Name: Player Resist Recovery - Death Blight
Fields.Description: Death Blight buildup the player loses per second.

Fields.Name: Player Resist Recovery - Frostbite
Fields.Description: Frostbite buildup the player loses per second.

Fields.Name: Enemy Resist Recovery - Poison
Fields.Description: Poison buildup enemies lose per second.

Fields.Name: Enemy Resist Recovery - Scarlet Rot
Fields.Description: Scarlet Rot buildup enemies lose per second.

Fields.Name: Enemy Resist Recovery - Blood Loss
Fields.Description: Blood Loss buildup enemies lose per second.

Fields.Name: Enemy Resist Recovery - Death Blight
Fields.Description: Death Blight buildup enemies lose per second.

Fields.Name: Enemy Resist Recovery - Frostbite
Fields.Description: Frostbite buildup enemies lose per second.

Fields.Name: Button Input Time for Both-Hand Left
Fields.Description: Button input time when holding both left hand

Fields.Name: Player Resist Recovery - Madness
Fields.Description: Madness buildup the player loses per second.

Fields.Name: Material Pick-up - Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation for gathering materials.

Fields.Name: HP Flask Reduction - Yellow Monk
Fields.Description: Yellow Cloth HP Est Bottle Correction Magnification

Fields.Name: HP Flask Offset - Yellow Monk
Fields.Description: Yellow Cloth HP Est Bottle Offset

Fields.Name: FP Flask Reduction - Yellow Monk
Fields.Description: Yellow Cloth MP Est Bottle Correction Magnification

Fields.Name: FP Flask Offset - Yellow Monk
Fields.Description: Yellow Cloth MP Est Bottle Offset

Fields.Name: Enemy Resist Recovery - Sleep
Fields.Description: Sleep buildup enemies lose per second.

Fields.Name: Enemy Resist Recovery - Madness
Fields.Description: Madness buildup enemies lose per second.

Fields.Name: Resist Curse Item ID
Fields.Description: Goods (EquipParamGoods) whose held count is recorded for the player; while at least one is held, the SpEffect Resist Curse SpEffect Base ID + count is applied. -1: none. Retail: -1.

Fields.Name: Restage: Tracked Character Limit
Fields.Description: How many characters Duchess's Restage tracks at once, nearest to the player first. Retail 5.

Fields.Name: Marking: Weak Point Duration
Fields.Description: Duration of the weak point Ironeye's Marking creates. An SpEffect of type "Extend Weakpoint Duration" replaces it with its own value. Retail 17.

Fields.Name: Resist Curse SpEffect Base ID
Fields.Description: Base SpEffect for Resist Curse Item ID: while the player holds N of that item, SpEffect (this + N) is applied. Retail: -1.
Appears unused by the game. Retail: -1.

Fields.Name: Restage Record Time
Fields.Description: Seconds of recent damage and effects that Duchess's Restage keeps for replay; older records are discarded. Retail: 3.

Fields.Name: Restage Damage Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on each recorded HP damage hit when Restage replays it (0.5 = half damage). Retail: 0.5.

Fields.Name: Restage Poise Damage Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on each recorded poise (stance) damage value when Restage replays it. Retail: 0.5.

Fields.Name: Restage Effect Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the value of each recorded effect application when Restage replays it. Retail: 0.5.

Fields.Name: Restage Replay Speed
Fields.Description: Playback speed of the Restage replay: recorded hits are re-applied as replay time advances at this multiple of real time. Retail: 1.

Fields.Name: Restage Phantom ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row used to draw the Restage phantom. Retail: 370 (Restage Phantom).

Fields.Name: Restage Fade-In Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the Restage phantom takes to fade in; the replay starts once this delay has passed. Retail: 0.55.

Fields.Name: Restage Fade-Out Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the Restage phantom takes to fade out at the end of the replay. Retail: 0.55.

Fields.Name: Restage Start Effect ID
Fields.Description: Effect played on the Restage phantom when it appears. Retail: 460801.

Fields.Name: Restage End Effect ID
Fields.Description: Effect played on the Restage phantom when it fades out. Retail: 460801.

Fields.Name: Revenant Summon 1: Buddy ID
Fields.Description: BuddyParam row of Revenant's first family member (summon slot 1); used to summon it and for its summon HUD icon and text. Retail: 27000000 (Helen).

Fields.Name: Revenant Summon 2: Buddy ID
Fields.Description: BuddyParam row of Revenant's second family member (summon slot 2). Retail: 27100000 (Frederick).

Fields.Name: Revenant Summon 3: Buddy ID
Fields.Description: BuddyParam row of Revenant's third family member (summon slot 3). Retail: 27200000 (Sebastian).

Fields.Name: Revenant Summon Leash Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in m: a summoned family member that is farther than this from Revenant is flagged to leave. Retail: 35.
Appears unused by the game. Retail: 720796.

Fields.Name: Beast Form Collision Value
Fields.Description: Character-collision value used for Executor's Beast form (character c0010) in place of the default (1.5 for characters in the large hit group, 0.3 otherwise). It is set next to the collision's maximum slope angles; its exact effect (likely the step height in m) is not established. Retail: 1.

Fields.Name: Revenant Summon HUD HP Threshold
Fields.Description: HP fraction (0-1) of a Revenant summon at or above which its HUD panel shows the healthy state; below it, the low-HP state. Retail: 0.5.

Fields.Name: Beast Form SpEffect Base ID
Fields.Description: Base SpEffect applied to the player and the Beast when Executor turns into the Beast; the player's stored level value (0-15) is added to the ID, picking "Beast Attack Boost - Level N". -1: none. Retail: 707200.

Fields.Name: Beast Form Revert SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied, with no level offset, to the player and the Beast when the Beast form reverts. -1: none. Retail: 707200 (Beast Attack Boost - Level 0).

Fields.Name: Claw Shot Wire Speed
Fields.Description: Speed in m/s at which the end of the Claw Shot wire travels toward its target point. Retail: 90.

Fields.Name: Marking Attack ID
Fields.Description: Player attack (AtkParam_Pc) of Ironeye's Marking. When a player attack with this ID hits, the hit part of the target becomes a marked weak point (see ScratchedPartsParam) for Marking: Weak Point Duration seconds. Retail: 600000110 ([Skill - Ironeye] Marking).

Fields.Name: Aim Snap Angle [deg]
Fields.Description: When the target lies within this angle of the character's facing, the aim direction is turned onto the target. Retail 17.

Fields.Name: Sixth Sense: Ready SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect kept on Wylder while his Sixth Sense passive has a charge left; the game also checks this effect to see whether Sixth Sense is ready. Retail: 700600.

Fields.Name: Sixth Sense: Spent SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect kept on Wylder while his Sixth Sense passive has no charge left. Retail: 700601.

Fields.Name: Soulblood Song HP Recovery
Fields.Description: Percent of the damage dealt that is restored as HP to an attacker under Soulblood Song's effect when hitting. Retail: 40.

Fields.Name: Soulblood Song FP Recovery
Fields.Description: Percent of the damage dealt that is restored as FP to an attacker under Soulblood Song's effect when hitting. Retail: 8.

Fields.Name: Soulblood Song: Attacker SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to a character that damages an enemy marked by Recluse's Soulblood Song, each time the hit restores HP or FP to it (see the Soulblood Song recovery rates). Retail: 706110.

Fields.Name: Target Search Distance [m]
Fields.Description: Distance of a player target search: the nearest character inside this distance and both angles below is picked. Retail 0 (the search never matches).

Fields.Name: Target Search Angle: Horizontal [deg]
Fields.Description: Horizontal angle of the player target search above. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Target Search Angle: Vertical [deg]
Fields.Description: Vertical angle of the player target search above. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Camera Aim Search Distance
Fields.Description: Length in m of the search for a character along the camera's view direction. The character found becomes the camera aim target used by Aim Ray Distance and Aim Target Min Distance. Retail: 48.

Fields.Name: Camera Aim Search Radius
Fields.Description: Radius in m of the camera aim search at its full distance; sets the on-screen pick radius. Retail: 0.6.

Fields.Name: Camera Turn Rate on Distant Aim Target
Fields.Description: Multiplier on stick camera turning while a camera aim target is found farther than Aim Target Min Distance (and the related game option is on). 1 = no slowdown. Retail: 0.65.

Fields.Name: Camera Turn Stick Curve
Fields.Description: Response curve of stick camera turning: the turn speed follows the stick tilt raised to the power (1 + this), so higher values make small tilts slower. Applies when the related game option is on. Retail: 1 (tilt squared).

Fields.Name: Aim Ray Distance
Fields.Description: Length in m of the ray cast along the camera direction to find the aim point; the first hit within this distance is used, and a camera aim target farther than Aim Target Min Distance overrides it with the target's distance. Retail: 48.

Fields.Name: Character Move Max Distance (Type 1)
Fields.Description: Distance in m used for type 1 of an animation-event-driven character move effect: the move's progress is the distance to its point divided by this, capped at 0.9. Retail: 2.7.

Fields.Name: Character Move Max Distance (Type 2)
Fields.Description: As Character Move Max Distance (Type 1), for type 2. Retail: 20.

Fields.Name: Character Move Max Distance (Type 3)
Fields.Description: As Character Move Max Distance (Type 1), for type 3. Retail: 23.

Fields.Name: Necromancy Chance
Fields.Description: Chance in % that a killed enemy rises as a ghost for Revenant's Necromancy; only enemies with Affected By Necromancy set (NpcParam) can rise. An effect on the killer that supplies its own chance (0 or more) replaces this value. Retail: 35.

Fields.Name: Necromancy SpEffect 1
Fields.Description: First of the SpEffects applied to a ghost raised by Revenant's Necromancy (followed by IDs 2-5). Retail: 705200 ([Passive - Revenant] Raised Ghost Added Effect).

Fields.Name: Necromancy SpEffect 2
Fields.Description: Second SpEffect applied to a raised ghost. Retail: 297000 ([Spirit Summon] Follow Player).

Fields.Name: Necromancy SpEffect 3
Fields.Description: Third SpEffect applied to a raised ghost. Retail: 705012 ([Hero] Flag as Hero/Player Character).

Fields.Name: Necromancy Range
Fields.Description: Distance in m from the player within which a dying enemy can rise through Revenant's Necromancy; risen spirits farther than this from the player are destroyed. Retail: 100.

Fields.Name: Necromancy Wait Slot Effect ID
Fields.Description: Effect created for a Necromancy spirit waiting in its slot. Retail: 461351.

Fields.Name: Aim Target Min Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in m beyond which a camera aim target is used: it sets the aim point's distance and enables Camera Turn Rate on Distant Aim Target. Closer targets are ignored. Retail: 4.5.

Fields.Name: Tenacity SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the player when a status ailment on them (poison, scarlet rot, blood loss, death blight, frostbite, sleep or madness) wears off; Executor's Tenacity passive. Retail: 707070 ([Passive - Executor] Tenacity (Start)).

Fields.Name: Necromancy SpEffect 4
Fields.Description: Fourth SpEffect applied to a spirit risen by Necromancy (after Necromancy SpEffects 1-3). Retail: 296400.

Fields.Name: Necromancy SpEffect 5
Fields.Description: Fifth SpEffect applied to a spirit risen by Necromancy. Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: c4460 Proximity Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in m from the local player: while a living character of model c4460 is this close, one animation event of the player is suppressed. Retail: 3.

Fields.Name: Tenacity: Extra SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: Second SpEffect applied at the same moment as Tenacity SpEffect ID. Retail: 7500701 ([Relic - Executor] Slowly Restore HP upon Ability Activation - HP Restore).

Fields.Name: Analysis Base Speed
Fields.Description: Analysis progress gained per second on the analysed target, before the multipliers below (Analysis Speed Rates and the distance graph). Progress is capped at 1000; the Analyse Progress levels are thresholds on it. Retail: 100.

Fields.Name: Analysis Level 1 Threshold
Fields.Description: Analysis progress (in % of full analysis) at which the analysed character reaches level 1. The level is the highest of levels 1-3 whose threshold is reached. Retail: 0.

Fields.Name: Analysis Level 2 Threshold
Fields.Description: Analysis progress (in %) at which level 2 is reached. Retail: 50.

Fields.Name: Analysis Level 3 Threshold
Fields.Description: Analysis progress (in %) at which level 3 is reached. Retail: 100.

Fields.Name: Analysis: Target SpEffect (Level 2)

Fields.Name: Analysis: Target SpEffect (Level 3)
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the analysed character at analysis level 3. Retail: 708020.

Fields.Name: Analysis: Analysed Ally SpEffect
